caption:
Gallup's report, Rebuilding Indian Workplaces for the Future, published mid-September, names something most professionals have been carrying privately: showing up at work without being psychologically invested in it.

You have read that as a character flaw. Years of watching your point get ignored, then praised when someone louder repeats it, teaches you to hold back. Withdrawal is what a sound mind does after repeated non-response. It is a predictable outcome, not a weakness.

That matters because a structural problem has a behavioural answer. In command, you do not fix low morale with sentiment. You fix it with bearing, with tone that carries weight, with silence held long enough to make the room wait for you.

Disengagement is information. It tells you the way you currently occupy a room is not getting through. Change the way you occupy it.

topic.title: Gallup India: present at work, not psychologically invested
